en.t: Servius Tullius, the king of Rome, celebrates a triumph for his victory over the Etruscans
en.s: Servius Tullius was the legendary sixth king of Rome, and the second of its Etruscan dynasty. He reigned from 578 to 535 BC. Roman and Greek sources describe his servile origins and later marriage to a daughter of Lucius Tarquinius Priscus, Rome's first Etruscan king, who was assassinated in 579 BC.

zh.t: 罗马国王塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯庆祝击败伊特鲁里亚人的胜利
zh.s: 塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯是罗马传说中的第六任国王，也是伊特鲁里亚王朝的第二位国王，在位时间为公元前578年至前535年。罗马和希腊史料记载，他出身卑微，后来娶了罗马首位伊特鲁里亚国王卢修斯·塔克文·布里斯库斯的女儿；后者于公元前579年遇刺。

en.s: The Battle of al-Uqhuwana (Arabic: يوم الأُقْحوَانة, romanized: Yawm al-Uqḥuwāna) was fought at a place east of Lake Tiberias in May 1029 between the Fatimid Caliphate under general Anushtakin al-Dizbari and a coalition of Syrian Arab Bedouin tribes. The Bedouin tribes were represented by the Tayy tribe of Palestine led by the Jarrahid emir Hassan ibn al-Mufarrij and the Kilab tribe of Aleppo under the Mirdasid emir Salih ibn Mirdas.

zh.s: 乌赫胡瓦纳战役（阿拉伯语：يوم الأُقْحوَانة，转写：Yawm al-Uqḥuwāna）于1029年5月在太巴列湖以东的一处地点爆发。交战双方是安努什塔金·迪兹巴里将军率领的法蒂玛哈里发国，以及叙利亚阿拉伯贝都因部落联盟。贝都因部落一方包括巴勒斯坦泰伊部落，其首领为贾拉希德埃米尔哈桑·伊本·穆法里吉；以及阿勒颇的基拉卜部落，其首领为米尔达西德埃米尔萨利赫·伊本·米尔达斯。

zh.s: 1181年，阿尔摩哈德哈里发国的一支军队入侵葡萄牙并围攻埃武拉城。

en.s: The Battle of Suchodoł was fought on 25 May 1243 between the Lesser Poland forces of Klement of Ruszcza, representing supporters of Boleslaw Wstydliwy, and supported by Hungarian troops of Béla IV of Hungary; against the Masovian forces of Konrad Mazowiecki, with further support by several units of Mieszko II the Fat.

zh.s: 苏霍多尔战役于1243年5月25日爆发。交战双方是小波兰军队与马佐夫舍军队。小波兰军由鲁斯恰的克莱门特率领，他代表支持博莱斯瓦夫五世的势力，并得到匈牙利国王贝拉四世的军队支援；马佐夫舍军则由康拉德·马佐维茨基率领，并得到胖子米什科二世所部数支部队增援。

en.t: Henry the Navigator is appointed governor of the Order of Christ
en.s: Prince Henry the Navigator (4 March 1394 – 13 December 1460), was a Portuguese prince, a central figure in the early days of the Portuguese Empire and often credited as one of the main initiators of the Age of Discovery. Henry was the third child of King John I of Portugal, who founded the House of Aviz.

zh.t: 航海家亨利获任基督骑士团团长
zh.s: 航海家亨利王子（1394年3月4日—1460年12月13日）是葡萄牙王子、葡萄牙帝国早期的重要人物，常被认为是大航海时代的主要推动者之一。他是葡萄牙国王若昂一世的第三个孩子；若昂一世创立了阿维什王朝。

en.s: The Battle of Eylau was a battle of the Thirteen Years' War, that took place on 25 May 1455, near the town of Eylau (now Iława, Poland). It was fought between forces of the Crown of the Kingdom of Poland, led by Ramsz Krzykowski, against the cavalry of the State of the Teutonic Order, led by Ludwig von Helfenstein, and John von Blanckenstein.

zh.s: 埃劳战役是十三年战争期间的一场战斗，于1455年5月25日在埃劳镇（今波兰伊瓦瓦）附近爆发。波兰王国王冠领地军队由拉姆什·克日科夫斯基率领，对阵条顿骑士团国的骑兵，后者由路德维希·冯·赫尔芬施泰因和约翰·冯·布兰肯施泰因率领。

en.s: The siege of Dongnae (Korean: 동래성 전투) was a siege that occurred on May 25, 1592 (Korean calendar: April 15, 1592) during the 1592–1598 Japanese invasions of Korea. It resulted in the capture by Japanese forces of Dongnaeeupseong, a mountain fortress on the way to Hanseong (Seoul).

zh.s: 东莱围城战（韩语：동래성 전투）发生于1592年5月25日，即韩国历四月十五日，属于1592年至1598年的日本侵略朝鲜战争。日军攻占东莱邑城，这是一座通往汉城（今首尔）途中的山城堡垒。

en.t: Ming–Qing transition: Ming general Wu Sangui allowed the invading Manchu to cross the Great Wall of China, enabling them to capture Beijing and establish the Qing dynasty
en.s: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications in China. They were built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states and Imperial China as protection against various nomadic groups from the Eurasian Steppe. The first walls date to the 7th century BC; these were joined together in the Qin dynasty. Successive dynasties expanded the wall system; the best-known sections were built by the Ming dynasty (1368–1644).

zh.t: 明清易代：明将吴三桂允许入侵的满洲军队越过长城，攻占北京并建立清朝
zh.s: 中国长城是一系列防御工事，沿古代中国各政权和帝制中国的历史北部边界修建，用以抵御来自欧亚草原的游牧群体。最早的城墙可追溯至公元前7世纪，后由秦朝连接起来。历代不断扩建长城体系，现今最著名的部分由明朝（1368—1644年）修建。

en.s: Battle of Passempe of 1646 (Makasar: Bundu’ka ri Passempe’), also called as Passempaka War or Pasompak War, was a military conflict in present-day Pasempe, which is situated approximately 10 kilometres west of Watampone. It was fought between the Gowa Sultanate and its allies led by Karaeng Cenrana as the head of the expedition, and rebellious vassal of Boné led by La Tenriaji.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1646年的帕森佩战役（望加锡语：Bundu’ka ri Passempe’），也称帕森帕卡战争或帕松帕克战争，是一场发生在今帕森佩地区的军事冲突。该地位于瓦坦波内以西约10公里。交战双方是戈瓦苏丹国及其盟友，以及由博内的反叛附庸组成的势力。戈瓦一方由远征军首领卡拉恩·切南拉率领，反叛一方由拉·特恩里亚吉率领。

en.t: Richard Cromwell resigns as Lord Protector of England following the restoration of the Long Parliament, beginning a second brief period of the republican government called the Commonwealth of England
en.s: Richard Cromwell (4 October 1626 – 12 July 1712) was an English statesman who served as Lord Protector of the Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland from 1658 to 1659. He was the son of Lord Protector Oliver Cromwell. Following his father's death in 1658, Richard became Lord Protector, but he lacked authority. He tried to mediate between the army and civil society, and allowed a Parliament that contained many disaffected Presbyterians and Royalists to sit.

zh.t: 理查德·克伦威尔在长期议会复辟后辞去英格兰护国公职务，共和政府短暂恢复
zh.s: 理查德·克伦威尔（1626年10月4日—1712年7月12日）是英格兰政治家，1658年至1659年担任英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰联邦护国公。他是奥利弗·克伦威尔护国公之子。父亲于1658年去世后，理查德继任护国公，但缺乏实权。他尝试调解军队与平民社会之间的关系，并允许由许多不满的长老会派和保王党人组成的议会开会。

en.s: The conquest of New Netherland occurred in 1664 as an English expedition led by Richard Nicolls that arrived in New York Harbor effected a peaceful capture of New Amsterdam and Fort Amsterdam, and the Articles of Surrender of New Netherland were agreed. The conquest was mostly peaceful in the rest of the colony as well, except for some fighting in New Amstel.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1664年，理查德·尼科尔斯率领的英国远征军抵达纽约港，和平占领新阿姆斯特丹和阿姆斯特丹堡，并达成《新尼德兰投降条款》，新尼德兰由此被英国征服。殖民地其他地区大多也和平易手，只有新阿姆斯特尔发生过一些战斗。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Bitonto (25 May 1734) was a Spanish victory over Austrian forces near Bitonto in the Kingdom of Naples (in southern Italy) in the War of Polish Succession. The battle ended organized Austrian resistance outside a small number of fortresses in the kingdom.

zh.s: 比通托战役于1734年5月25日在那不勒斯王国南部比通托附近爆发。波兰王位继承战争期间，西班牙军队击败奥地利军队，取得胜利。战役结束后，奥军在该王国内除少数堡垒外的有组织抵抗也告终。

en.t: First issue of Norske Intelligenz-Seddeler, the first regular Norwegian newspaper (1763–1920)
en.s: Norske Intelligenz-Seddeler is a former Norwegian newspaper issued in Oslo from 1763 to 1920. It was the first newspaper in Norway, and its first issue came out on 25 May 1763. The founder and first publisher of Norske Intelligenz-Seddeler was printer Samuel Conrad Schwach, who edited the newspaper until he died in 1781. In the beginning, the publication was a weekly magazine.

zh.s: 《挪威情报报》是挪威的一份报纸，1763年至1920年在奥斯陆发行，也是挪威第一份报纸。创刊号于1763年5月25日出版。创办人兼首任发行人是印刷商塞缪尔·康拉德·施瓦希，他一直担任编辑，直至1781年去世。该报最初每周出版一次。

en.s: The Crawford expedition, also known as the Battle of Sandusky, the Sandusky expedition, and Crawford's Defeat, was a 1782 campaign on the western front of the American Revolutionary War, and one of the final operations of the conflict. The campaign was led by Colonel William Crawford, an experienced officer who had served in the Continental Army and a childhood friend of George Washington.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克劳福德远征又称桑达斯基战役、桑达斯基远征或克劳福德败战，是1782年美国独立战争西线的一场军事行动，也是战争最后阶段的行动之一。远征由威廉·克劳福德上校率领。他曾在大陆军服役，是一位经验丰富的军官，也是乔治·华盛顿的儿时好友。

en.s: The Constitutional Convention took place in Philadelphia from May 25 to September 17, 1787. While the convention was initially intended to revise the league of states and the first system of federal government under the Articles of Confederation, leading proponents of the Constitutional Convention, including James Madison of Virginia and Alexander Hamilton of New York, sought to create a new frame of government rather than revise the existing one.

zh.s: 美国制宪会议于1787年5月25日至9月17日在费城举行。会议最初计划修订邦联条例以及美国第一套联邦政府体制，但弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯·麦迪逊和纽约州的亚历山大·汉密尔顿等主要推动者希望另行制定新的政体框架，而不是修改现有制度。

en.s: The French expedition to Sardinia was a short military campaign fought in 1793 in the Mediterranean Sea in the first year of the War of the First Coalition, during the French Revolutionary Wars. The operation was the first offensive by the new French Republic in the Mediterranean during the conflict, and was directed at the island of Sardinia, part of the Kingdom of Sardinia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国远征撒丁岛是1793年第一次反法同盟战争期间、法国大革命战争初期在地中海进行的一场短期军事行动。这是法兰西共和国在这场冲突中首次向地中海发动进攻，目标是萨丁王国所属的撒丁岛。

en.s: The Battle of Carlow took place in Carlow town, Ireland on 25 May 1798 when Carlow rebels rose in support of the 1798 rebellion which had begun the day before in County Kildare. The United Irish organisation in Carlow led by a young brogue-maker named Mick Heydon who had taken over the leadership following the arrest of the previous leader, Peter Ivers, who was arrested with several other leading United Irishmen at Oliver Bond's house in March of that year, had assembled on the night of the 24th and set off at dawn to attack the county town.

zh.s: 1798年5月25日，爱尔兰卡洛镇的起义者起兵支持1798年爱尔兰起义；这场起义于前一天在基尔代尔郡爆发。卡洛的联合爱尔兰人组织由年轻的鞋匠米克·海登领导。他接替了此前被捕的彼得·艾弗斯；艾弗斯当年3月在奥利弗·邦德家中与数名联合爱尔兰人领袖一同被捕。5月24日晚，起义者集结，黎明时出发攻打郡城。

en.s: The Battle of Frauenfeld was a military encounter during the War of the Second Coalition (1799-1802). It took place on 25 May 1799 between Austrian and French troops. The battle ended in the evening with the retreat of the Austrians, but on the following day the French withdrew.

zh.s: 弗劳恩费尔德战役是第二次反法同盟战争（1799—1802年）期间的一场军事交战，于1799年5月25日在奥军和法军之间爆发。当天傍晚奥军撤退，次日法军也撤离。

en.t: Outbreak of the Kabakçı Mustafa rebellion in response to intentions of sultan Selim III to reform the Ottoman army
en.s: Kabakçı Mustafa (c. 1770 – 14 July 1808) was a rebel leader who caused the delay of Ottoman reformation in the early 19th century.

zh.t: 卡巴克奇·穆斯塔法起义爆发，反对苏丹塞利姆三世改革奥斯曼军队
zh.s: 卡巴克奇·穆斯塔法（约1770年—1808年7月14日）是叛乱领袖，导致19世纪初奥斯曼帝国改革进程延误。

loc: 奥地利上施泰尔马克圣米夏埃尔

en.s: In the Battle of Sankt Michael (or Sankt Michael-Leoben) on 25 May 1809, Paul Grenier's French corps crushed Franz Jellacic's Austrian division at Sankt Michael in Obersteiermark, Austria. The action occurred after the initial French victories during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. Sankt Michael is located approximately 140 kilometers southwest of Vienna. Originally part of the Danube army of Archduke Charles, Jellacic's division was detached to the south before the Battle of Eckmühl and later ordered to join the army of Archduke John at Graz.

zh.s: 1809年5月25日，法军保罗·格雷尼耶军团在奥地利上施泰尔马克的圣米夏埃尔击溃弗朗茨·耶拉契奇率领的奥军师，这场战斗也称圣米夏埃尔-莱奥本战役。战斗发生在第五次反法同盟战争期间，处于法军早期获胜之后。圣米夏埃尔位于维也纳西南约140公里处。耶拉契奇的师原属卡尔大公的多瑙河军团，在埃克米尔战役前被调往南方，之后奉命前往格拉茨加入约翰大公的军队。

en.s: The Chuquisaca Revolution was a popular uprising on 25 May 1809 against the governor and intendant of Chuquisaca (today Sucre), Ramón García León de Pizarro. The Real Audiencia of Charcas, with support from the faculty of University of Saint Francis Xavier, deposed the governor and formed a junta.

zh.s: 1809年5月25日，丘基萨卡（今苏克雷）发生民众起义，反对总督兼行政长官拉蒙·加西亚·莱昂·德·皮萨罗。查尔卡斯皇家审理院在圣弗朗西斯科·哈维尔大学教职人员的支持下，罢免了总督并成立执政委员会。

en.s: The Bolivian War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de Independencia de Bolivia, 1809–1825) began with the establishment of government juntas in Sucre and La Paz after the Chuquisaca Revolution and La Paz revolution. These Juntas, part of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, were defeated shortly after by Peruvian royalist forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 玻利维亚独立战争（西班牙语：Guerra de Independencia de Bolivia，1809—1825）始于苏克雷和拉巴斯成立执政委员会。这些委员会在丘基萨卡革命和拉巴斯革命后成立，属于拉普拉塔总督辖区，随后不久被秘鲁保王派军队击败。

en.s: The May Revolution (Spanish: Revolución de Mayo) was a week-long series of events that took place from 18 to 25 May 1810, in Buenos Aires, capital of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. This Spanish colony included roughly the territories of present-day Argentina, Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay, and parts of Brazil.

zh.s: 五月革命是1810年5月18日至25日在布宜诺斯艾利斯发生的一系列事件，为期一周。当时布宜诺斯艾利斯是拉普拉塔总督辖区的首府。这个西班牙殖民地大致包括今天阿根廷、玻利维亚、巴拉圭、乌拉圭和巴西部分地区。

en.s: In the Battle of Usagre on 25 May 1811, Anglo-Allied cavalry commanded by Major-General William Lumley routed a French cavalry force led by Major-General Marie Victor Latour-Maubourg at the village of Usagre, Spain, in the Peninsular War. Beforehand, Lumley explored the area; the British hid their forces behind the ridge where they cannot be seen, while the French found themselves in a disadvantageous position when they were caught crossing the river and unable to exploit their numerical superiority.

zh.s: 1811年5月25日，半岛战争期间，威廉·卢姆利少将率领的英葡盟军骑兵在西班牙乌萨格雷村击溃了玛丽·维克托·拉图尔-莫布尔少将率领的法军骑兵。此前，卢姆利曾侦察当地；英军躲在山脊后，法军看不到他们。法军过河时陷入不利位置，无法发挥兵力优势。

en.s: The Battle of Arlabán, also known as the First Surprise of Arlabán, took place at the heights of Arlabán, the mountain pass that separates the Basque provinces of Guipúzcoa and Álava, on 25 May 1811, during the Peninsular War.

zh.s: 阿拉班山口战役又称“阿拉班山口第一次突袭”，于1811年5月25日在阿拉班山口高地爆发。该山口分隔巴斯克地区的吉普斯夸省和阿拉瓦省，战斗发生在半岛战争期间。

en.t: Battle of Alto de los Godos
en.s: The Battle of Alto de los Godos was a battle that took place on 25 May 1813 in Maturín, Venezuela, in the Spanish colonial Viceroyalty of New Granada. It resulted in a patriot victory against the forces of Spanish general Domingo de Monteverde. It was one of the five attempts by the royalists to regain control over the region and it is notable for its inclusion of women in combat, such as Juana Ramírez, who was also known as "The Advancer" (La Avanzadora).

zh.s: 戈多斯高地战役于1813年5月25日在委内瑞拉马图林爆发，当地当时属于西班牙殖民地新格拉纳达总督辖区。爱国军击败了西班牙将军多明戈·德·蒙特韦德率领的部队。这是保王党试图夺回该地区控制权的五次行动之一。胡安娜·拉米雷斯等女性也参加了战斗；拉米雷斯又被称为“先驱者”（La Avanzadora）。

en.s: The Argentine Constitution of 1819 was a Constitution drafted by the Congress of Tucumán in 1819, shortly after the Argentine War of Independence. It was promoted by Buenos Aires but rejected by the other provinces and did not come into force.
en.n: The Argentine Constitution of 1819 is promulgated.

en.s: The Constitution of 1833 was the constitution used in Chile from 1833 to 1925 when it was replaced by the Constitution of 1925. One of the most long-lived constitutions of Latin America, it was used to endorse both an authoritarian, presidential system and from 1891 onwards an oligarchic, parliamentary system. The constitution emerged after the Chilean Civil War of 1829 in which the conservative Pelucones (Whigs) defeated the Pipiolos (liberals).
en.n: The Chilean Constitution of 1833 is promulgated.

zh.s: 智利1833年宪法自1833年起施行，至1925年被新宪法取代。它是拉丁美洲施行时间最长的宪法之一，既被用于支持威权总统制，也从1891年起被用于支持寡头议会制。这部宪法是在1829年智利内战后制定的；内战中，保守派佩卢科内斯（辉格党人）击败了自由派皮皮奥洛斯。
zh.n: 1833年智利宪法颁布。

en.s: The First Battle of Winchester, fought on May 25, 1862, in and around Frederick County, Virginia, and Winchester, Virginia, was a major victory in Confederate Army Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's Campaign through the Shenandoah Valley during the American Civil War. Jackson enveloped the right flank of the Union Army under Maj. Gen. Nathaniel P. Banks and pursued it as it fled across the Potomac River into Maryland.

zh.s: 第一次温彻斯特战役于1862年5月25日在弗吉尼亚州弗雷德里克县及温彻斯特周边爆发，是美国内战期间托马斯·J·“石墙”杰克逊少将率领邦联军在谢南多厄山谷行动中的一次重大胜利。杰克逊迂回到纳撒尼尔·P·班克斯少将率领的联邦军右翼，并追击逃过波托马克河、进入马里兰州的联邦军。

en.s: On May 25, 1865, in Mobile, Alabama, in the Southern United States, an ordnance depot or "magazine" exploded, killing some 300 persons. This event occurred just after the end of the American Civil War, during the occupation of the city by victorious Federal troops. The depot was a warehouse on Beauregard Street, where the troops had stacked some 200 tons of shells and powder. Some time in the afternoon of May 25, a cloud of black smoke rose into the air and the ground began to rumble. Flames shot up into the sky and bursting shells were heard throughout the city.

zh.s: 1865年5月25日，美国南部阿拉巴马州莫比尔的一座军火库（magazine）发生爆炸，约300人死亡。当时美国内战刚结束，联邦军胜利后仍占领该市。军火库是位于博雷加德街的一处仓库，军队在那里堆放了约200吨炮弹和火药。5月25日下午某个时刻，黑烟升上天空，地面开始震动；火焰窜向空中，炮弹爆炸声传遍全城。

en.s: The Battle of Eccles Hill () was part of a raid into Canadian territory from the United States led by John O'Neill of the Fenian Brotherhood, intended to pressure Great Britain to grant sovereignty to Ireland. In 1870, the Fenians crossed the Canadian border and proceeded to the top of Eccles Hill where they were confronted by members of the Canadian home guard and volunteers. The Fenians were overwhelmed by local militia units and armed citizens on May 25, 1870, and were compelled to abandon what was anticipated to have been a "glorious victory".

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 25 May 1902.The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 54 of the 85 seats up for election in the Chamber of Representatives. Voter turnout was 95.7%. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders. In addition to the regular elections for these 85 seats, elections were held for one seat (6 in total) in Ghent-Eeklo, Aalst, Soignies, Charleroi, Liège and Verviers because the number of representatives increased for these electoral arrondissements following the population census.

zh.s: 1902年5月25日，比利时举行部分大选。天主教党获胜，在众议院待改选的85席中赢得54席。投票率为95.7%。根据轮替制度，本次只在9个省中的5个举行选举：安特卫普、布拉班特、卢森堡、那慕尔和西佛兰德。此外，因人口普查后根特-埃克洛、阿尔斯特、索尼、沙勒罗瓦、列日和韦尔维耶各选区的代表人数增加，这些选区还另外改选各1席，共6席。

en.t: Japan and China reached a series of agreements which ratified the first four sets of goals on 25 May 1915
en.s: The Twenty-One Demands was a set of demands made during the First World War by the Empire of Japan under Prime Minister Ōkuma Shigenobu to the government of the Republic of China on 18 January 1915. The secret demands would greatly extend Japanese control of China. Japan would keep the former German leased territory it had conquered at the start of World War I in 1914 and would have increased influence in Manchuria and Inner Mongolia while having an expanded role in railways.

zh.t: 日本与中国达成一系列协议，并于1915年5月25日批准前四组目标

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 11 May and 25 May 1924. They resulted in a victory for the left-wing Cartel des Gauches, an alliance of Radicals and Socialists, which governed until July 1926 under the premierships of Édouard Herriot, Paul Painlevé and Aristide Briand.

en.n: Scopes Trial: John T. Scopes is indicted for teaching human evolution in Tennessee.

en.s: The 1955 British Kangchenjunga expedition succeeded in climbing the 28,168-foot (8,586 m) Kangchenjunga, the third highest mountain in the world, for the first time. The expedition complied with a request from the Sikkim authorities that the summit should not be trodden on so the climbers deliberately stopped about five feet below the summit. George Band and Joe Brown reached the top on 25 May 1955, and they were followed the next day by Norman Hardie and Tony Streather.

Matheson took over as premier from his predecessor J.

en.s: The Apollo program, also known as Project Apollo, was the United States human spaceflight program led by NASA, which landed the first humans on the Moon in 1969. The Apollo program was conceived in 1960 in the Dwight D. Eisenhower presidency during Project Mercury and executed after Project Gemini. The Apollo program was later dedicated to President John F. Kennedy's national goal, "before this decade is out, of landing a man on the Moon and returning him safely to the Earth" in his address to the U.S. Congress on May 25, 1961.

zh.s: 阿波罗计划（又称“阿波罗项目”）是由美国国家航空航天局（NASA）领导的载人航天计划，于 1969 年实现人类首次登月。该计划于 1960 年艾森豪威尔总统任内构想，在水星计划期间提出，并在双子星计划之后实施。后来，计划承载了约翰·F·肯尼迪总统提出的国家目标：在“这个十年结束之前，将人类送上月球并安全返回地球”。肯尼迪于 1961 年 5 月 25 日在美国国会演讲中提出了这一目标。

en.s: The 1963 FA Cup final was the ultimate match of the 1962–63 FA Cup, the 82nd edition of the first English club football tournament. Having been postponed for three weeks due to a fixture backlog caused by the "Big Freeze" of the winter months, the final was played on 25 May 1963.

en.t: The Organisation of African Unity is established in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
en.s: The Organisation of African Unity (OAU; French: Organisation de l'unité africaine, OUA) was an African intergovernmental organisation established on 25 May 1963 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, with 33 signatory governments. Some of the key aims of the OAU were to encourage political and economic integration among member states, and to eradicate colonialism and neo-colonialism from the African continent.

zh.t: 非洲统一组织在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴成立
zh.s: 非洲统一组织（简称OAU；法语：Organisation de l'unité africaine，简称OUA）于1963年5月25日在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴成立，当时有33个政府签署成立文件。组织的主要目标包括推动成员国之间的政治和经济一体化，以及消除非洲大陆的殖民主义和新殖民主义。

en.s: The 1967 European Cup final was a football match contested between Italian team Internazionale and Scottish team Celtic to determine the champion of the 1966–67 European Cup. en.s: On May 25, 1976, an election was held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. Incumbent mayor Neil Goldschmidt won reelection, defeating city commissioner Frank Ivancie. zh.t: 1976年俄勒冈州波特兰市长选举
zh.s: 1976年5月25日，俄勒冈州波特兰举行市长选举。时任市长尼尔·戈德施密特击败市政专员弗兰克·伊万西连任。波特兰地方选举不设党派限制，所有选民均可投票，候选人以无党派身份列在选票上。所有符合资格的候选人都参加了1976年5月25日举行的开放式初选。

en.s: The 1976 Arkansas Democratic Party presidential primary was held on May 25 as part of the 1976 Democratic Party presidential primaries to elect 26 delegates to the 1976 Democratic National Convention. en.s: Hands Across America was a public fundraising event held on Sunday, May 25, 1986, Memorial Day weekend, which attempted to create a continuous human chain of people holding hands across the contiguous United States. While approximately 5 million people participated, the chain was broken in many places, particularly in the Southwestern desert.

zh.s: “携手横贯美国”是一次公开募款活动，于1986年5月25日、阵亡将士纪念日周末的星期日举行。活动试图让参与者手拉手，在美国本土48州连成一条连续的人链。约有500万人参加，但人链在多处中断，尤其是在西南部沙漠地带。

en.s: The 1988 European Cup final was a football match played between PSV Eindhoven of the Netherlands and Benfica of Portugal to decide the champion of the 1987–88 European Cup. PSV won 6–5 on penalties after a goalless draw after extra time. The match was played at Neckarstadion, Stuttgart, on 25 May 1988. According to PSV player Berry van Aerle, it was not a particularly good match, with both teams very cautious.

zh.s: 1988年欧洲冠军杯决赛是荷兰埃因霍温对阵葡萄牙本菲卡的足球比赛，决出1987—88赛季欧洲冠军杯冠军。双方加时赛后仍以0比0战平，埃因霍温在点球大战中以6比5获胜。比赛于1988年5月25日在斯图加特内卡体育场举行。埃因霍温球员贝里·范阿尔勒表示，双方踢得相当谨慎，比赛并不精彩。

en.s: Elections to the 50th Parliament of New South Wales were held on Saturday 25 May 1991. All seats in the Legislative Assembly and half the seats in the Legislative Council were up for election. The Liberal–National Coalition government of Premier Nick Greiner, which enjoyed a considerable majority following their landslide win at the 1988 election, was seeking a second term in office against new Labor Opposition Leader Bob Carr.

zh.s: 1991年5月25日（星期六）举行新南威尔士州第50届议会选举。立法议会全部席位和立法委员会一半席位开放竞选。州长尼克·格雷纳领导的自由党—国家党联盟政府在1988年大胜后拥有明显多数，此次争取连任，对手是新任工党反对党领袖鲍勃·卡尔。

en.t: 1992 Football League Second Division play-off final
en.s: The 1992 Football League Second Division play-off final was an association football match, which was played on 25 May 1992 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Blackburn Rovers and Leicester City. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Second Division, the second tier of English football, to the inaugural season of the Premier League.

zh.t: 1992年英格兰足球联赛第二级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1992年英格兰足球联赛第二级附加赛决赛于1992年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由布莱克本流浪者对阵莱斯特城。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛第二级升入刚成立的英超联赛的球队。

en.s: The 1992 Italian presidential election was held in Italy on 13–25 May 1992, following the resignation of President Francesco Cossiga on 28 April 1992. Only members of Parliament and regional delegates were entitled to vote, most of these electors having been elected in the 1992 general election and in the 1990 regional elections.

zh.s: 1992年5月13日至25日，意大利举行总统选举。此前，总统弗朗切斯科·科西加于4月28日辞职。只有议员和各大区代表有权投票；其中大多数选举人是在1992年意大利大选和1990年各大区选举中当选的。

en.s: The 1993 Nova Scotia general election was held on May 25, 1993, to elect members of the 56th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. The Liberals under John Savage won a landslide victory over the unpopular Progressive Conservatives under Premier Donald Cameron, while Alexa McDonough's NDP remained a distant third, winning three seats.

zh.s: 1993年5月25日，加拿大新斯科舍省举行大选，选出该省第56届众议院议员。约翰·萨维奇领导的自由党大胜人气低落的进步保守党；当时进步保守党由省长唐纳德·卡梅伦领导。亚历克莎·麦克唐纳领导的新民主党仍远居第三，赢得3席。

en.s: The 1993 Guatemala constitutional crisis took place in 1993 when then President Jorge Serrano Elías attempted a self-coup or autogolpe. On Tuesday May 25, 1993, Serrano illegally suspended the constitution, dissolved Congress and the Supreme Court, imposed censorship, and tried to restrict civil freedom.

en.s: A by-election for the UK Parliament constituency of Perth and Kinross in Scotland was held on 25 May 1995, following the death of Conservative MP Sir Nicholas Fairbairn on 19 February of that year. The result was a Scottish National Party gain from the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1995年5月25日，苏格兰珀斯和金罗斯英国国会选区举行补选。此前，保守党议员尼古拉斯·费尔贝恩爵士于当年2月19日去世。苏格兰民族党赢得该席位，取代保守党。

en.s: The 1996 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1995–96 DFB-Pokal, the 53rd season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 25 May 1996 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. 1. FC Kaiserslautern won the match 1–0 against Karlsruher SC to claim their second cup title, qualifying for the 1996–97 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup and the 1996 DFB-Supercup.

zh.s: 1996年德国杯决赛决出了1995—96赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛第53个赛季的决赛。比赛于1996年5月25日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。凯泽斯劳滕以1比0击败卡尔斯鲁厄，第二次夺得德国杯，并获得1996—97赛季欧洲优胜者杯和1996年德国超级杯的参赛资格。

en.t: 1996 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 1996 Football League Third Division play-off final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium on 25 May 1996, to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Third Division to the Second Division of the Football League in the 1995–96 season. It was contested by Plymouth Argyle, who finished fourth in the Third Division table, and Darlington, who finished fifth.

zh.t: 1996年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1996年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于1996年5月25日在温布利球场举行，决出1995—96赛季从第三级升入英格兰足球联赛第二级的第4支、也是最后一支球队。对阵双方是第三级联赛排名第4的普利茅斯阿盖尔和排名第5的达灵顿。

en.t: 1997 Football League Second Division play-off final
en.s: The 1997 Football League Second Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 1997 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Crewe Alexandra and Brentford. The top two teams of the 1996–97 Football League Second Division league, Bury and Stockport County, gained automatic promotion to the First Division, while the teams placed from third to sixth place in the table took part in play-offs.

zh.t: 1997年英格兰足球联赛第二级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1997年英格兰足球联赛第二级附加赛决赛于1997年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由克鲁亚历山德拉对阵布伦特福德。1996—97赛季英格兰足球联赛第二级联赛排名前两位的伯里和斯托克波特郡自动升入甲级联赛；排名第三至第六的球队则参加附加赛。

en.s: The 1997 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the NSC Olimpiyskiy on 25 May 1997. The match was the 6th Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by FC Shakhtar Donetsk and FC Dnipro Dnipropetrovsk. The 1997 Ukrainian Cup Final was the fifth to be held in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Shakhtar won by a single goal netted by Serhiy Atelkin in the 36th minute.

zh.s: 1997年乌克兰杯决赛于1997年5月25日在基辅奥林匹克国家体育中心举行，是乌克兰杯第6届决赛，也是该赛事第5次在首都基辅举行。对阵双方是顿涅茨克矿工和第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克第聂伯队。顿涅茨克矿工凭谢尔希·阿特尔金第36分钟的进球，以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1997 National Soccer League Grand Final was held on 25 May 1997 between Brisbane Strikers and Sydney United at Lang Park. Brisbane gained home advantage because despite finishing below United on the league standings, they defeated the Sydney side in the major semi-final two weeks earlier. The teams were all locked up at half time, however two goals for the Strikers by Frank Farina and Rod Brown secured their first NSL championship.

zh.t: 1997年澳大利亚国家足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 1997年澳大利亚国家足球联赛总决赛于1997年5月25日举行，由布里斯班前锋对阵悉尼联，比赛场地是兰福德公园球场。虽然布里斯班在联赛排名中低于悉尼联，但他们在两周前的主要半决赛中击败了这支悉尼球队，因此获得主场优势。半场时双方战平；布里斯班前锋由弗兰克·法里纳和罗德·布朗各进一球，锁定胜局并首度夺得国家足球联赛冠军。

en.s: The siege of Freetown was a battle during the Sierra Leone Civil War. It began when Johnny Paul Koroma took over the power from Ahmad Tejan Kabbah and began a dictatorship. In response, ECOMOG troops, led by Nigeria, helped the Sierra Leone Army to attack and remove Koroma from power and Kabbah was elected back in post. In revenge, Koroma's allies, the RUF, assaulted the city but were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 弗里敦围城战是塞拉利昂内战期间的一场战斗。约翰尼·保罗·科罗马夺取阿哈迈德·泰詹·卡巴的权力并建立独裁统治后，战斗爆发。尼日利亚领导的西非国家经济共同体监测团部队协助塞拉利昂军队进攻科罗马并将其赶下台，卡巴随后重新当选。为报复，科罗马的盟友革命联合阵线袭击该市，但被迫撤退。

en.t: 1998 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 1998 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match played on 25 May 1998 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Charlton Athletic and Sunderland. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League First Division, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League for the 1998–99 season.

zh.t: 1998年英格兰足球联赛第一级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1998年英格兰足球联赛第一级附加赛决赛于1998年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由查尔顿竞技对阵桑德兰。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛第一级（当时英格兰第二级别联赛）升入1998—99赛季英超的球队。

en.s: The 1998 Iraqi Perseverance Cup (Arabic: كأس المثابرة العراقي 1998) was the 3rd edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. The match was contested between Baghdad rivals Al-Shorta and Al-Zawraa at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad. It was played on 25 May 1998 to bring an end to the 1997–98 season. Al-Zawraa won the game 1–0, earning their first Super Cup title.

zh.s: 1998年伊拉克坚忍杯（阿拉伯语：كأس المثابرة العراقي 1998）是第三届伊拉克超级杯。比赛由巴格达的两支球队警察俱乐部和扎瓦拉俱乐部在巴格达的人民体育场对阵。比赛于1998年5月25日举行，为1997—98赛季画上句号。扎瓦拉俱乐部以1比0获胜，首次夺得超级杯冠军。

en.s: Local elections were held in Croatia on 25 May 2001. It was the third time the country had held local elections since independence, and the first time since democratization. Voting at 6,430 separate polling stations across Croatia for members of representative bodies of local and regional self-government units, the citizens elected members for a total of 423 municipal and 122 city councils, as well as members for 20 county assemblies, and the Zagreb City Assembly.

zh.s: 2001年5月25日，克罗地亚举行地方选举。这是该国独立后第三次举行地方选举，也是民主化以来的首次地方选举。选民在全国6430个投票站投票，选出地方和区域自治机构的代表，包括423个市镇议会、122个城市议会、20个郡议会以及萨格勒布市议会议员。

en.s: China Airlines Flight 611 was a regularly scheduled international passenger flight operated by a Boeing 747-200 from Chiang Kai-shek International Airport (now Taoyuan International Airport) in Taiwan to Hong Kong International Airport. On May 25th, 2002, the flight disintegrated midair and crashed into the Taiwan Strait, 26 miles (23 nmi; 42 km) northeast of the Penghu Islands, 20 minutes after takeoff, killing all 225 people on board.

zh.s: 中华航空611号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，由波音747-200型客机执飞，往返于台湾的中正国际机场（现桃园国际机场）和香港国际机场。2002年5月25日，飞机起飞20分钟后在空中解体，坠入澎湖群岛东北方26英里（23海里；42公里）处的台湾海峡，机上225人全部遇难。

en.s: The 2002 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 2001–02 Heineken Cup, the seventh season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The match was played on 25 May 2002 at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff; this was the third time the final had been played in Cardiff after the 1996 and 1997 finals, but the first since the opening of the Millennium Stadium, which was built on the site of the old Cardiff Arms Park for the 1999 Rugby World Cup.

zh.s: 2002年喜力杯决赛是2001—02赛季喜力杯的最后一场比赛，也是这项欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第七个赛季的收官战。比赛于2002年5月25日在加的夫千禧球场举行。这是决赛第三次在加的夫举办；此前两次分别在1996年和1997年，但这是1999年橄榄球世界杯期间建成千禧球场、并取代原加的夫武器公园球场之后，决赛首次在此举行。

en.s: The 2003 Spanish local elections were held on Sunday, 25 May 2003, throughout all 8,108 Spain municipalities, simultaneously with regional elections in 13 of the 17 autonomous communities—all except for Andalusia, the Basque Country, Catalonia, and Galicia. All 65,510 councillors were up for election, as well as 153 seats of the 3 Basque Juntas Generales, 149 seats of the 7 Canarian cabildos and the indirectly-elected 1,036 seats of the 38 provincial deputations.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日（星期日），西班牙8108个市镇全部举行地方选举，同时有17个自治区中的13个举行地方议会选举；安达卢西亚、巴斯克地区、加泰罗尼亚和加利西亚除外。此次改选全部65,510名地方议员，以及巴斯克地区3个省级议会中的153席、加那利群岛7个岛议会中的149席，还有38个省级代表机构中以间接方式选出的1036席。

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，西班牙阿斯图里亚斯公国举行选举，选出第六届总议会，全部45席均进行改选。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Valencia on 25 May 2003 to elect the 7th City Council of the municipality. All 33 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in thirteen autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，西班牙瓦伦西亚举行市议会选举，改选市议会全部33席。这次选举与西班牙13个自治区的地方议会选举及全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in Aragon on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Cortes of the autonomous community. All 67 seats in the Cortes were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain. The election saw the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE), which had ruled Aragon since the previous election, becoming the largest party in the Courts for the first time since the 1991 election.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，西班牙阿拉贡自治区举行选举，选出第六届自治区议会，全部67席均进行改选。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。自上次选举以来一直执政的西班牙工人社会党（PSOE）首次成为议会第一大党；该党上一次成为议会第一大党是在1991年。

en.s: The 2003 Cantabrian regional election was held on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Parliament of the autonomous community of Cantabria. All 39 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in 12 other autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain. Both the People's Party (PP) and the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) lost 1 seat each to the Regionalist Party of Cantabria (PRC), which won 8 seats.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，西班牙坎塔布里亚自治区举行选举，选出第六届自治区议会，全部39席均进行改选。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。人民党（PP）和西班牙工人社会党（PSOE）各失去1席，坎塔布里亚地区党（PRC）则赢得8席。

en.s: A regional election was held in Extremadura on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Assembly of the autonomous community. All 65 seats in the Assembly were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.t: 2003年埃斯特雷马杜拉自治区选举
zh.s: 2003年5月25日，西班牙埃斯特雷马杜拉自治区举行选举，选出第六届自治区议会，全部65席均进行改选。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2003 Ceuta Assembly election was held on Sunday, 25 May 2003, to elect the 3rd Assembly of the Autonomous City of Ceuta. All 25 seats in the Assembly were up for election. The election was held simultaneously with regional elections in thirteen autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日（星期日），西班牙自治市休达举行选举，选出第三届议会，全部25席均进行改选。选举与西班牙13个自治区的地方议会选举及全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The Reckoning was the fifth and final professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling All-Stars (WWA). The event took place on May 25, 2003 at the North Shore Events Centre in Auckland, New Zealand. The event aired via tape delay in the United States on June 8, 2003. Six professional wrestling matches were contested at the event.

zh.s: 《清算》是世界摔角全明星（WWA）举办的第5场、也是最后一场职业摔角付费赛事。赛事于2003年5月25日在新西兰奥克兰北岸活动中心举行，并于2003年6月8日在美国延迟播出。赛事共进行了6场职业摔角比赛。

en.s: The 2003 Rioja regional election was held on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Parliament of the autonomous community of La Rioja. All 33 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，西班牙拉里奥哈自治区举行选举，选出第六届自治区议会，全部33席均进行改选。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2003 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the NSC Olimpiyskiy on 25 May 2003. The match was the 12th Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by Dynamo Kyiv and Shakhtar Donetsk. The 2003 Ukrainian Cup Final was the 12th to be held in the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv. Dynamo won the match 2–1.

zh.s: 2003年乌克兰杯决赛于2003年5月25日在基辅奥林匹克国家体育中心举行，是乌克兰杯第12届决赛，也是该赛事第12次在基辅举行。对阵双方是基辅迪纳摩和顿涅茨克矿工。基辅迪纳摩以2比1获胜。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Canary Islands on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 60 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，加那利群岛举行地方议会选举，选出第六届自治区议会，全部60席均进行改选。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Valencian Community on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Corts of the autonomous community. All 89 seats in the Corts were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 2003年5月25日，瓦伦西亚自治区举行地方议会选举，改选自治区议会（Corts）全部89席。选举与其他12个自治区的地方议会选举及西班牙全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2003 Melilla Assembly election was held on Sunday, 25 May 2003, to elect the 3rd Assembly of the Autonomous City of Melilla. All 25 seats in the Assembly were up for election. The election was held simultaneously with regional elections in thirteen autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain.

zh.t: 2003年梅利利亚自治区议会选举
zh.s: 梅利利亚于2003年5月25日（星期日）举行议会选举，选出该自治区的第三届议会。议会全部25个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙13个自治区的地方选举及全国各地的市政选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Balearic Islands on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 59 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.t: 2003年巴利阿里群岛自治区选举
zh.s: 巴利阿里群岛于2003年5月25日举行自治区议会选举，选出该自治区第六届议会。全部59个议席均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外12个自治区的选举及全国各地的市政选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in Castile and León on 25 May 2003 to elect the 6th Cortes of the autonomous community. All 82 seats in the Cortes were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.t: 2003年卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区选举
zh.s: 卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂于2003年5月25日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第六届议会（Cortes）。全部82个议席均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外12个自治区的选举及全国各地的市政选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2003 Bremen state election was held on 25 May 2003 to elect the members of the Bürgerschaft of Bremen, as well as the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The incumbent grand coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and Christian Democratic Union (CDU) led by Mayor Henning Scherf retained its majority and continued in office.

zh.s: 不来梅于2003年5月25日举行州选举，选举不来梅州议会成员，同时选举不来梅市和不来梅哈芬市议会。由市长亨宁·舍尔夫领导的社会民主党（SPD）与基督教民主联盟（CDU）执政大联盟保住多数席位，继续执政。

en.t: 2003 Football League Second Division play-off final
en.s: The 2003 Football League Second Division play-off final was a football match played at the Millennium Stadium on 25 May 2003, at the end of the 2002–03 season. The match determined the third and final team to gain promotion from the English Second Division to the First Division, and was contested by fourth-placed Queens Park Rangers and sixth-placed Cardiff City.

zh.t: 2003年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2003年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2003年5月25日、2002—03赛季结束时在千禧球场举行。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第三支从英格兰乙级联赛升入甲级联赛的球队。参赛双方是联赛排名第四的女王公园巡游者和排名第六的卡迪夫城。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Seville on 25 May 2003 to elect the 7th City Council of the municipality. All 33 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in thirteen autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 塞维利亚于2003年5月25日举行市政选举，选出该市第七届市议会。市议会全部33个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙13个自治区的选举及全国各地的市政选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2004 Idaho Republican presidential primary was held on May 25, 2004, to choose the state's 26 pledged delegates to the 2004 Republican National Convention. Incumbent President George W. Bush won the primary and all of the state's delegates.

zh.t: 2004年爱达荷州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2004年5月25日，爱达荷州举行共和党总统初选，选出该州参加2004年共和党全国代表大会的26名承诺代表。时任总统乔治·W·布什赢得初选，并获得该州全部代表席位。

en.s: The 2005 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia on 25 May 2005 and was contested between the sides of Levski Sofia and CSKA Sofia. The match was refereed by Anton Genov and was won by Levski Sofia. The win gave Levski their 24th Bulgarian Cup success.

zh.s: 2005年保加利亚杯决赛于5月25日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，参赛双方是索非亚列夫斯基和索非亚中央陆军。比赛由安东·格诺夫执法，最终列夫斯基获胜，这是球队第24次夺得保加利亚杯。

en.s: The 2005 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2004–05 UEFA Champions League, Europe's primary club football competition. The showpiece event was contested between Milan of Italy and Liverpool of England at the Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul on 25 May 2005. Liverpool, who had won the competition four times, were appearing in their sixth final, and their first since 1985.

zh.s: 2005年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2004—05赛季欧洲冠军联赛的决赛，也是欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事的收官战。意大利的AC米兰与英格兰的利物浦于2005年5月25日在伊斯坦布尔阿塔图尔克奥林匹克体育场交锋。此前已四次夺冠的利物浦第六次闯入决赛，也是自1985年以来首次进入决赛。

en.s: Operation Astute was an Australian-led military deployment to East Timor to quell unrest and return stability in the 2006 East Timor crisis. It was headed by Brigadier Bill Sowry, and commenced on 25 May 2006 under the command of Brigadier Michael Slater. The operation was established at the request of East Timor's government, and continues under an understanding reached between Australia, East Timor, and the United Nations, with the United Nations Integrated Mission in East Timor supporting and helping to develop East Timor's police force. Other countries deploying soldiers to East Timor include Malaysia, New Zealand and East Timor's former colonial power Portugal, operating under independent command.

zh.s: 敏锐行动是澳大利亚牵头的一次东帝汶军事部署，目的是平息2006年东帝汶危机期间的动乱、恢复稳定。行动由比尔·索里准将率领，于2006年5月25日在迈克尔·斯莱特准将指挥下启动。行动应东帝汶政府请求设立，之后由澳大利亚、东帝汶和联合国达成的协议支持。联合国东帝汶综合特派团也参与行动，协助培养东帝汶警察部队。马来西亚、新西兰和东帝汶前殖民宗主国葡萄牙也派兵前往，各自独立指挥。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2007) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from May 18, 2007, over the course of four of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on June 8, 2007. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.s: 2007年银色传奇杯是墨西哥摔角推广机构墨西哥摔角理事会（CMLL，西班牙语“世界摔角理事会”）举办的职业摔角赛事。从2007年5月18日起，赛事在墨西哥竞技场举行，共安排四场周五晚间演出，决赛于6月8日举行。银色传奇杯每年举办一次，向摔角传奇人物埃尔·桑托致敬，也是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Parliament of Lebanon on 25 May 2008, after the term of incumbent President Émile Lahoud expired on 24 November 2007 at midnight. General Michel Sleiman, the Commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces, was elected as the consensus candidate after months of delays in holding the election due to an ongoing political dispute. By convention, the presidency is usually attributed to a Maronite Christian personality. Under the article 49 of the Lebanese Constitution, a qualified majority of two-thirds of the members of the 128-seat Lebanese Parliament is required to elect the president.

zh.s: 2008年5月25日，黎巴嫩议会举行间接总统选举。时任总统埃米尔·拉胡德的任期已于2007年11月24日午夜届满；由于政治争端，选举拖延数月才举行。黎巴嫩武装部队司令米歇尔·苏莱曼作为各方共识人选当选。按惯例，总统一职通常由马龙派基督徒担任。根据《黎巴嫩宪法》第49条，选出总统须获得128席议会中三分之二议员支持。

en.s: The 2008 Football League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 2008 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Doncaster Rovers and Leeds United to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from Football League One to the Football League Championship.

zh.t: 2008年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2008年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于2008年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由唐卡斯特流浪者对阵利兹联。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入英格兰足球联赛冠军级的球队。

en.s: Snap mayoral and city council elections were held in Kyiv on 25 May 2008. The election, originally scheduled to be held alongside nationwide 2010 local elections, was called by the Verkhovna Rada by a 246–5 vote on March 18 amid corruption allegations involving the incumbent Mayor Leonid Chernovetskyi. The local election determined the new Mayor of Kyiv, as well as the composition of the 120-seat Kyiv City Council.

zh.s: 2008年5月25日，基辅举行市长和市议会提前选举。选举原定与2010年全国地方选举同时举行，但因时任市长列昂尼德·切尔诺韦茨基被指控腐败，乌克兰最高拉达于3月18日以246票赞成、5票反对通过提前举行选举的决定。此次选举选出基辅新市长，并改选市议会全部120席。

en.s: 2008 Egypt Cup final, was the final match of 2007–08 Egypt Cup, when Zamalek played ENPPI at Cairo Stadium in Cairo. Zamalek won the game 2–1, claiming the cup for the 21st time.

zh.s: 2008年埃及杯决赛是2007—08赛季埃及杯的最后一场比赛。扎马雷克在开罗体育场对阵恩比俱乐部，最终以2比1获胜，第21次夺得埃及杯。

en.s: The 2009 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 2009 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Burnley and Sheffield United. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.s: 2009年英格兰足球联赛冠军级附加赛决赛于2009年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由伯恩利对阵谢菲尔德联。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛冠军级（英格兰第二级别联赛）升入英超的球队。

en.s: The Battle of Do Ab took place in Nuristan province, Afghanistan on 25 May 2011. In the battle, a scout platoon from the 1st Battalion, 133rd Infantry Regiment, United States Army, 20 Afghan soldiers, and two United States Air Force Tactical Air Control Party (TACP) operators and one Law Enforcement Professional (LEP) were ambushed by an estimated 400-500 Taliban near the village of Do Ab. With assistance from close air support, the coalition forces repulsed the ambush, killing approximately 270 Taliban. The coalition forces suffered no casualties.

zh.s: 2011年5月25日，阿富汗努里斯坦省发生多阿布战役。美国陆军第133步兵团第1营的一支侦察排、20名阿富汗士兵、两名美国空军战术空中控制组（TACP）成员和一名执法专业人员（LEP），在多阿布村附近遭约400至500名塔利班武装人员伏击。在近距离空中支援下，联军击退伏击，约270名塔利班人员被打死。联军无人伤亡。

en.s: The 2011 Cupa României final was the 11th final of the Cupa României between the archrivals Dinamo București and Steaua București. The match took place on 25 May 2011 at the Silviu Ploeşteanu stadium in Brașov. Steaua won the 21st cup in the club's history after beating Dinamo 2–1.

zh.s: 2011年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该项赛事第11届决赛，由宿敌布加勒斯特迪纳摩和布加勒斯特星队对阵。比赛于2011年5月25日在布拉索夫的西尔维乌·普洛耶什泰亚努球场举行。布加勒斯特星队以2比1击败迪纳摩，赢得队史第21座杯赛冠军。

en.s: The 2011 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that was played at the Yuvileiny Stadium, Sumy, on 25 May 2011. The match was the 20th Ukrainian Cup Final and was contested by Dynamo Kyiv and Shakhtar Donetsk. This was the first time a Ukrainian Cup final was played in Sumy.

zh.s: 2011年乌克兰杯决赛于2011年5月25日在苏梅的尤比列伊内体育场举行，是第20届乌克兰杯决赛。参赛双方是基辅迪纳摩和顿涅茨克矿工。这是乌克兰杯决赛首次在苏梅举行。

en.s: The 2011 Bulgarian Cup final was the 71st final of the Bulgarian Cup. The match took place on 25 May 2011 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. The match was contested by CSKA Sofia, who beat Litex Lovech 2–1 in their semi-final, and Slavia Sofia who beat Pirin Blagoevgrad 7–6 on penalties after a 1–1 draw after extra time.

zh.s: 2011年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事的第71届决赛，于2011年5月25日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行。参赛双方是索非亚中央陆军和索非亚斯拉维亚。中央陆军在半决赛中以2比1击败洛维奇利特克斯；斯拉维亚则在加时赛1比1战平后，通过点球大战以7比6击败布拉戈耶夫格勒皮林。

en.s: The 2011 Liga Indonesia Premier Division final was a football match which was played on Wednesday, 25 May 2011.

zh.s: 2011年印尼足球甲级联赛决赛于2011年5月25日星期三举行。

en.s: The 2012 Copa del Rey final was the 110th final since the tournament's establishment (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was contested by Athletic Bilbao and Barcelona on 25 May 2012 at the Vicente Calderón in Madrid. This was the clubs' first meeting in the final since 2009 where Barcelona won the trophy with a 4–1 victory.

zh.s: 2012年西班牙国王杯决赛是该赛事成立以来的第110届决赛，其中包括曾有两个赛季举行过两场彼此对立的赛事。比赛于2012年5月25日在马德里的维森特·卡尔德隆球场举行，由毕尔巴鄂竞技对阵巴塞罗那。两队上一次在决赛相遇是在2009年，当时巴塞罗那以4比1获胜夺冠。

en.s: The Houla massacre (Arabic: مجزرة الحولة) was a mass murder of civilians that took place on May 25, 2012, in the midst of the Syrian Civil War, in the town of Taldou, in the Houla Region of Syria, a string of towns northwest of Homs. According to the United Nations, 108 people were killed, including 34 women and 49 children.

zh.s: 2012年5月25日，叙利亚内战期间，胡拉地区塔尔杜镇发生针对平民的大规模屠杀。胡拉地区由霍姆斯西北方向的一连串城镇组成。联合国称，共有108人遇害，其中包括34名妇女和49名儿童。

en.t: The SpaceX Dragon 1 becomes the first commercial spacecraft to successfully rendezvous and berth with the International Space Station
en.s: SpaceX Dragon 1 is a class of fourteen partially reusable cargo spacecraft developed by SpaceX, an American private space transportation company. The spacecraft flew 23 missions between 2010 and 2020. Dragon was launched into orbit by the company's Falcon 9 launch vehicle to resupply the International Space Station (ISS). It was succeeded by the Dragon 2 spacecraft which has both crewed and cargo versions.

zh.t: SpaceX龙飞船1号成为首艘成功与国际空间站交会并停靠的商业航天器
zh.s: SpaceX龙飞船1号是美国私人航天运输公司SpaceX研制的一型货运飞船，共有14艘部分可重复使用的飞船。该型飞船于2010年至2020年间执行了23次任务，由SpaceX猎鹰9号运载火箭送入轨道，为国际空间站补给。之后由龙飞船2号接替，后者有载人和货运两种型号。

en.s: On 25 May 2013, Naxalite insurgents of the Communist Party of India (Maoist) attacked a convoy of Indian National Congress leaders in the Darbha Valley in the Sukma district of Chhattisgarh, India. The attack caused at least 27 deaths, including that of former state minister Mahendra Karma and Chhattisgarh Congress chief Nand Kumar Patel. Vidya Charan Shukla, a senior Congress leader, succumbed to his injuries on 11 June 2013.

zh.t: 2013年达尔巴河谷纳萨尔派袭击
zh.s: 2013年5月25日，印度共产党（毛主义）旗下的纳萨尔派武装在印度恰蒂斯加尔邦苏克马县达尔巴河谷袭击了一支印度国民大会党领导人车队。袭击至少造成27人死亡，其中包括前邦部长马亨德拉·卡尔马和恰蒂斯加尔邦国大党主席南德·库马尔·帕特尔。资深国大党领袖维迪亚·查兰·舒克拉于2013年6月11日伤重不治。

zh.s: UFC 160：维拉斯奎兹对阵“大脚”二番战是一场综合格斗赛事，于2013年5月25日在内华达州拉斯维加斯的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2013 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2012–13 UEFA Champions League, the 58th season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 21st season since it was renamed from the European Champion Clubs' Cup to the UEFA Champions League. The match took place on Saturday, 25 May 2013, at Wembley Stadium in London, England, between German Bundesliga clubs Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich.

zh.s: 2013年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2012—13赛季欧洲冠军联赛的决赛，为欧洲足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第58个赛季的决赛，也是赛事从欧洲冠军俱乐部杯更名为欧洲冠军联赛后的第21个赛季的决赛。比赛于2013年5月25日（星期六）在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，由德国甲级联赛球队多特蒙德和拜仁慕尼黑对阵。

en.s: A by-election was held for the New South Wales Legislative Assembly seat of Northern Tablelands on 25 May 2013. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of independent member Richard Torbay, which was announced on 20 March 2013. Adam Marshall was declared elected on 28 May 2013.

zh.t: 2013年新南威尔士州北部高原选区补选
zh.s: 新南威尔士州立法议会北部高原选区于2013年5月25日举行补选。此次补选由独立议员理查德·托贝辞职引发，他于2013年3月20日宣布辞职。亚当·马歇尔于5月28日被宣布当选。

en.s: The 2013 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Team Bath and Celtic Dragons. Team Bath secured their fifth Netball Superleague title in eight years with a victory over Dragons. Dragons, who were playing their first grand final won the second quarter by two points to lead 31–30 at half-time. However Team Bath fought back and entered the final quarter with a two-point advantage at 46–44.

zh.t: 2013年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2013年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由巴斯大学队对阵凯尔特龙队。巴斯大学队击败对手，八年内第五次夺得联赛冠军。首次打进总决赛的凯尔特龙队在第二节赢了两分，半场以31比30领先。巴斯大学队随后反超，并以46比44的两分优势进入最后一节。

en.s: The 2013 Pro12 Grand Final was the final match of the 2012–13 Pro12 season. The 2012–13 season was the second with RaboDirect as title sponsor and the fourth ever League Grand Final. Leinster won the game 24–18 against Ulster. The win for Leinster ended a run of three successive league final losses.

zh.s: 2013年Pro12联赛总决赛是2012—13赛季Pro12联赛的最后一场比赛。该赛季是RaboDirect冠名赞助的第二个赛季，也是联赛设立总决赛后的第四个赛季。伦斯特以24比18击败阿尔斯特，结束了连续三次在联赛决赛中失利的纪录。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on May 25, 2014. Since no candidate received 50% of the vote in the first round, a run-off between the two candidates with the most votes took place three weeks later on June 15, 2014. According to the official figures released by the National Registry office (Registraduría Nacional), as of May 22, 2014 (the cut-off date to register) 32,975,158 Colombians were registered and entitled to vote in the 2014 presidential election, including 545,976 Colombians resident abroad. Incumbent president Juan Manuel Santos was allowed to run for a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚于2014年5月25日举行总统选举。由于首轮没有候选人获得50%的选票，得票最多的两名候选人于三周后的6月15日参加第二轮投票。根据国家登记处（Registraduría Nacional）公布的官方数据，截至2014年5月22日登记截止日，共有32,975,158名哥伦比亚人登记并有资格投票，其中545,976人居住在海外。时任总统胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯获准竞选连任，开启连续第二个任期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Ukraine on 25 May 2014, resulting in Petro Poroshenko being elected President of Ukraine. Originally scheduled to take place on 29 March 2015, the date was changed following the 2014 Ukrainian revolution. Poroshenko won the elections with 54.7% of the votes. His closest competitor was Yulia Tymoshenko, who emerged with 12.81% of the votes. The Central Election Commission reported voter turnout at over 60% excluding those regions not under government control. Since Poroshenko obtained an absolute majority in the first round, a run-off second ballot (on 15 June 2014) was unnecessary. The elections were not held throughout Ukraine.

zh.s: 乌克兰于2014年5月25日举行总统选举，彼得·波罗申科当选总统。选举原定于2015年3月29日举行，后因2014年乌克兰革命而提前。波罗申科以54.7%的得票率胜出，最接近他的对手尤利娅·季莫申科获得12.81%的选票。中央选举委员会报告称，不包括政府无法控制地区，投票率超过60%。波罗申科在首轮投票中获得绝对多数，因此无需举行原定于2014年6月15日的第二轮投票。选举并未在乌克兰全境举行。

en.s: Prisión Fatal (May 2014) was a professional wrestling major event, produced by the Mexico based International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) professional wrestling promotion. The event took on May 25, 2014, at "Arena Naucalpan" in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, IWRG's main venue. The show was the third overall show promoted under the Prisión Fatal name and the first of two shows in 2014 billed as Prisión Fatal. The main event was the eponymous Prisión Fatal (Spanish for "Deadly Prison") Steel cage match where the last person remaining in the cage was forced to unmasked or shaved bald as per the match stipulation.

zh.s: 《致命监狱》（Prisión Fatal，西班牙语意为“致命监狱”）是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的一场大型职业摔角赛事。赛事于2014年5月25日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的IWRG主场瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。这是以《致命监狱》为名的第3场赛事，也是2014年两场同名赛事中的首场。主赛是同名钢笼赛，按照赛制，最后留在笼中的选手必须摘下面具或剃光头。

en.s: The Piedmontese regional election of 2014 took place on 25 May 2014. It was a snap election, prompted by the dissolution of the Regional Council by the Regional Administrative Tribunal on the grounds that one of the lists supporting Roberto Cota (Lega Nord–Piemont) in the 2010 regional election (which saw Cota narrowly defeating Mercedes Bresso, the incumbent Democratic President) had committed irregularities in filing the slates for the election. In 2014 Cota chose not to stand again for President and the parties composing his coalition failed to agree on a single candidate, resulting in a landslide victory for Sergio Chiamparino, a Democrat who had been Mayor of Turin from 2001 to 2011.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，意大利皮埃蒙特大区举行提前选举。此前，大区行政法院裁定，支持罗伯托·科塔在2010年大区选举中参选的名单之一（北方联盟—皮埃蒙特）在提交候选人名单时违规，因此解散大区议会。2010年选举中，科塔以微弱优势击败时任民主党籍大区主席梅赛德斯·布雷索。科塔决定不再竞选主席，其联盟内各党也未能就单一候选人达成一致。民主党人塞尔焦·基亚帕里诺因此大胜；他曾于2001年至2011年担任都灵市长。

en.s: The 2014 Ukrainian local elections took place on May 25, 2014, four years after the conclusion of the last local elections, which took place in October 2010. The elections occurred during the political crisis in the aftermath of the 2014 Ukrainian revolution. Although the Verkhovna Rada did not schedule early local elections for entire Ukraine, it announced early elections in a number of places throughout Ukraine, including mayoral elections for some large cities, such as Odessa and Kiev. Overall, mayoral elections occurred in 43 cities, 27 settlements, and 200 villages, in addition to 2 city council and 3 village council elections, throughout 14 of Ukraine's 24 oblasts, and were also scheduled to take place in the Autonomous Republic of Crimea.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，乌克兰举行地方选举，距离上次于2010年10月举行地方选举已过去四年。选举在2014年乌克兰革命后的政治危机期间举行。乌克兰最高拉达没有安排全国范围的提前地方选举，但在全国多地宣布举行提前选举，包括敖德萨、基辅等大城市的市长选举。此次共有43个城市、27个市镇和200个村庄举行市长选举，另有2场市议会选举和3场村议会选举，覆盖乌克兰24个州中的14个州；克里米亚自治共和国也原定举行选举。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Dewan Rakyat parliamentary seat of Bukit Gelugor on 25 May 2014 following the nomination day on 12 May 2014. The seat fell vacant after the passing of the incumbent MP, Karpal Singh in a motor accident near Kampar, Perak on 17 April 2014. Karpal hailed from the Democratic Action Party, a component party of Pakatan Rakyat. A political and legal veteran, he served in the Parliament since 1978 (except for a brief period) and as the chairman of the DAP from 2004 until 2014.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，马来西亚国会下议院武吉牛汝莪选区举行补选，候选人提名日为5月12日。时任议员卡巴星于2014年4月17日在霹雳州金宝附近遭遇车祸身亡后，该席位出缺。卡巴星来自人民联盟成员党民主行动党。他是资深政治人物和律师，除一段短暂时期外，自1978年起担任国会议员，并于2004年至2014年担任民主行动党主席。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Belgium on 25 May 2014 to choose representatives for the Flemish Parliament, Walloon Parliament, Brussels Parliament and the Parliament of the German-speaking Community. These elections were held on the same day as the 2014 European elections as well as the 2014 Belgian federal election. The Parliament of the French Community is composed of all elected members of the Walloon Parliament (except German-speaking members) and 19 of the French-speaking members of the Brussels Parliament.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，比利时举行大区选举，选出弗拉芒议会、瓦隆议会、布鲁塞尔议会和德语社群议会的代表。此次选举与2014年欧洲议会选举及比利时联邦选举同日举行。法语社群议会由瓦隆议会所有当选议员（德语议员除外）以及布鲁塞尔议会19名法语议员组成。

en.s: You Only Live Twice was a professional wrestling internet pay-per-view (iPPV) event produced by the Chikara promotion, that took place on May 25, 2014, at the Palmer Center in Easton, Pennsylvania. The event marked Chikara's fifth iPPV and first event since Aniversario: Never Compromise in June 2013.

zh.t: 奇卡拉《你只活两次》赛事
zh.s: 《你只活两次》是职业摔角推广公司奇卡拉举办的一场网络付费赛事，于2014年5月25日在宾夕法尼亚州伊斯顿的帕尔默中心举行。这是奇卡拉举办的第5场网络付费赛事，也是该公司自2013年6月《周年庆：绝不妥协》以来举办的首场赛事。

en.s: The 2014 European Parliament election in Austria was held on 25 May 2014 in Austria. As a result of the Lisbon Treaty Austria held 19 seats in the European Parliament, but with Croatia joining the Union in 2013, Austria's allocation was reduced to 18 seats.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，奥地利举行欧洲议会选举。根据《里斯本条约》，奥地利在欧洲议会原有19席；但克罗地亚于2013年加入欧盟后，奥地利的席位减至18席。

en.s: European Parliament elections in Sweden took place on 25 May 2014. At the election, twenty Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) were from the Swedish constituency. In the election, voters choose members of registered Swedish parties whose elected members then form political groups in the European Parliament, together with members of parties from other Member States with the same political affiliation.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，瑞典举行欧洲议会选举。瑞典选区在本次选举中选出20名欧洲议会议员。选民投票支持瑞典登记政党的候选人；当选议员随后与其他成员国政治立场相同的政党议员组成欧洲议会党团。

en.s: An election was held on 25 May 2014 in the three Belgian constituencies (the Dutch-speaking electoral college, the French-speaking electoral college and the German-speaking electoral college) to elect the Belgian delegation to the European Parliament. This election, part of the 2014 European Parliament election, was held on the same day alongside the Belgian federal election and the Belgian regional elections.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，比利时在三个选区举行选举，即荷兰语选举团、法语选举团和德语选举团，选出比利时派往欧洲议会的代表。此次选举是2014年欧洲议会选举的一部分，并与比利时联邦选举和大区选举同日举行。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Greece on 25 May 2014 to elect the 21 Greek members of the European Parliament. The number of seats allocated to Greece declined from 22 to 21, as a result of the 2013 reapportionment of seats in the European Parliament. The election marked a significant milestone as the left-wing SYRIZA party emerged as the largest party for the first time, securing 26.6% of the votes.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，希腊举行欧洲议会选举，选出21名希腊籍欧洲议会议员。由于2013年欧洲议会席位重新分配，希腊席位从22席减至21席。左翼联盟党首次成为最大党，获得26.6%的选票，这是选举中的重要转折。

en.s: The 2014 European Parliament election in Poland elected the delegation from Poland to the European Parliament. It took place on 25 May 2014. The Polish electorate will elect 51 MEPs, compared to 50 in the 2009 election. (In December 2011, under the terms of the Lisbon Treaty, one additional MEP from the People's Party entered the Parliament, bringing the number of Polish MEPs to 51).

zh.s: 2014年波兰欧洲议会选举选出了波兰派往欧洲议会的代表，于2014年5月25日举行。波兰选民将选出51名欧洲议会议员，而2009年选举时为50名。2011年12月，依据《里斯本条约》，人民党另有一名欧洲议会议员进入议会，使波兰议员总数增至51人。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Croatia on 25 May 2014. These were the second elections to the European Parliament in Croatia since the country's accession to the European Union was completed in 2013. The country formed a single constituency, with members elected by proportional representation using open lists.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，克罗地亚举行欧洲议会选举。这是克罗地亚于2013年完成加入欧盟后举行的第二次欧洲议会选举。全国划为一个选区，议员采用开放名单比例代表制选出。

en.s: An election was held in Portugal on Sunday, 25 May 2014, to elect the Portuguese delegation to the European Parliament from 2014 to 2019. This was the seventh European Parliament election held in Portugal. The Socialist Party (PS) was the winner of the election, scoring 31.5 percent of the votes. The Socialists increased their share of vote by almost 5 percentage points, and won one more seat compared with 2009.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日（星期日），葡萄牙举行选举，选出2014年至2019年任期的欧洲议会议员。这是葡萄牙第七次举行欧洲议会选举。社会党获胜，得票率为31.5%；与2009年相比，该党得票率提高近5个百分点，并多赢得1席。

en.s: An election was held in Spain on 25 May 2014 as part of the concurrent EU-wide election to the 8th European Parliament. All 54 seats allocated to the Spanish constituency as per the Treaty of Lisbon were up for election. The People's Party (PP) emerged as the largest party overall, albeit with its worst nationwide election result in 25 years with a mere 26.1% of the share and 16 seats, losing 2.6 million votes and 8 seats from its 2009 result.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，西班牙举行选举，选出第八届欧洲议会的西班牙议员。依据《里斯本条约》，西班牙选区分配到的54席全部进行改选。人民党（PP）仍是第一大党，但得票率仅为26.1%，拿下16席，创该党25年来在全国选举中的最差成绩；与2009年相比，得票减少260万张，议席减少8席。

en.s: Cyprus's component of the 2014 European Parliament election was held on Sunday, 25 May 2014. In total, 6 Members of the European Parliament were elected from Cyprus.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日（星期日），塞浦路斯举行欧洲议会选举，共选出6名塞浦路斯籍欧洲议会议员。

en.s: The 2014 Football League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 2014 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Leyton Orient and Rotherham United to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from Football League One to the Football League Championship.

zh.t: 2014年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2014年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于2014年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由莱顿东方对阵罗瑟勒姆联。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入冠军级的球队。

en.s: An election of the Members of the European Parliament from Bulgaria to the European Parliament was held on 25 May 2014 as part of the larger European Parliament election. After a decision by the European Council in 2013, Bulgaria was allocated 17 seats in the European Parliament for the Eighth European Parliament. The election campaign officially began on 25 April 2014, one month before the election day.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，保加利亚举行选举，选出派往欧洲议会的议员，这是欧洲议会选举的一部分。欧洲理事会于2013年作出决定后，保加利亚获得第八届欧洲议会的17个席位。竞选活动于2014年4月25日正式开始，即投票日前一个月。

en.s: The 2014 European Parliament election in Romania was held in Romania on 25 May 2014.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于2014年5月25日举行欧洲议会选举。

en.s: An election for Members of the European Parliament from Estonia to the European Parliament was held on 25 May 2014.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，爱沙尼亚举行欧洲议会选举，选出爱沙尼亚派往欧洲议会的议员。

en.s: 2014 European Parliament elections were held in Slovenia on 25 May 2014. It was the first in the series of three elections held in the 2014, and the major test leading up to the parliamentary elections in July. The political atmosphere was in a crisis that started with the fall of Borut Pahor's government, then Janez Janša's government in 2013, the latter coming after Janša was accused of corruption.

zh.t: 2014年斯洛文尼亚欧洲议会选举
zh.s: 2014年5月25日，斯洛文尼亚举行欧洲议会选举。这是2014年接连三场选举中的第一场，也是7月国会选举前的一次重要检验。政治局势陷入危机，最初是在博鲁特·帕霍尔政府下台后，随后亚内兹·扬沙政府也于2013年垮台；扬沙被控腐败是后者下台的背景。

en.s: An election for the election of the delegation from Finland to the European Parliament took place on 25 May 2014 with advance voting from 14 to 20 May. Finnish voters elected thirteen members to the European Parliament.

zh.s: 芬兰于2014年5月25日举行欧洲议会选举，选出芬兰派往欧洲议会的代表；提前投票于5月14日至20日进行。芬兰选民共选出13名欧洲议会议员。

en.s: Local elections in Kyiv for the post of Mayor and members of Kyiv City Council took place on 25 May 2014, as part of the 2014 Ukrainian local elections. Vitali Klitschko won the mayoral election with almost 57% of the votes, while his party the Ukrainian Democratic Alliance for Reform won 73 of the 120 seats in the Kyiv City Council.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，基辅举行地方选举，选出市长和市议会议员。这是2014年乌克兰地方选举的一部分。维塔利·克利奇科以近57%的选票当选市长；他领导的乌克兰民主改革联盟在基辅市议会120席中赢得73席。

en.s: An election of Members of the European Parliament from Hungary to the European Parliament was held on 25 May 2014. With the Lisbon Treaty coming into force, Hungary held 22 seats in the European Parliament. However, because Croatia joined the EU in 2013, it now holds 21 seats to the Parliament.

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，匈牙利举行选举，选出派往欧洲议会的议员。《里斯本条约》生效后，匈牙利原有22个席位；但克罗地亚于2013年加入欧盟后，匈牙利在欧洲议会的席位减至21个。

en.s: The 2014 European Parliament election in Italy took place on 25 May 2014. Italy elected 73 MEPs out of 751 European Parliament seats. The governing Democratic Party (PD) won the election with 40.8% of the vote and 31 seats, followed by the Five Star Movement (21.2% and 17 seats) and Forza Italia (16.8% and 13 seats).

zh.s: 2014年5月25日，意大利举行欧洲议会选举。在欧洲议会751席中，意大利选出73名议员。执政的民主党（PD）以40.8%的得票率赢得31席，位居第一；五星运动党得票率为21.2%，赢得17席；力量党得票率为16.8%，赢得13席。

en.s: The 2014 Saarland local elections were held on May 25, 2014 to elect members of Saarland's 6 district councils and 52 municipal councils. The elections were held on the same day as the 2014 European Parliament election in Germany.

zh.s: 萨尔州于2014年5月25日举行地方选举，选出该州6个县议会和52个市镇议会的成员。选举与2014年德国欧洲议会选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2014 European Parliament election was held in the European Union (EU) between 22 and 25 May 2014. It was the 8th parliamentary election since the first direct elections in 1979, and the first in which the European political parties fielded candidates for President of the Commission.

zh.s: 欧洲联盟于2014年5月22日至25日举行欧洲议会选举。这是自1979年首次直接选举以来的第八次议会选举，也是欧洲政党首次推举欧盟委员会主席候选人参选。

en.s: The Abruzzo regional election of 2014 took place on 25 May 2014. The Democratic candidate Luciano D'Alfonso, a former Christian Democrat who had been mayor of Pescara in 2003–2009, defeated incumbent President Giovanni Chiodi of Forza Italia by a wide margin.

zh.s: 阿布鲁佐大区于2014年5月25日举行选举。民主党候选人卢恰诺·达尔丰索曾于2003至2009年担任佩斯卡拉市长，他以较大优势击败了意大利力量党籍的时任大区主席乔瓦尼·基奥迪。

en.s: The 67th Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 25 May 2014. New Zealand filmmaker Jane Campion was the head of the jury for the main competition. Turkish filmmaker Nuri Bilge Ceylan won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the drama film Winter Sleep. The festival poster featured Italian actor Marcello Mastroianni from Federico Fellini's 1963 film 8½, which was presented in the Out of Competition section of the 1963 Cannes Film Festival.

In the second round, incumbent President Dalia Grybauskaitė was re-elected with 58% of the vote. Second round took place alongside the 2014 European elections.

en.s: The 2015 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 2015 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Middlesbrough and Norwich City. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.s: 2015年英冠附加赛决赛于2015年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由米德尔斯堡对阵诺里奇城。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球冠军联赛（英格兰第二级联赛）升入英超的球队。

en.s: The 2016 Slovenian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2015–16 Slovenian Football Cup to decide the winner of the 25th edition of the Slovenian Football Cup, Slovenia's top knockout tournament. It was played on 25 May 2016 at Bonifika Stadium in Koper and was won by Maribor, who defeated Celje on penalties after the match ended in a 2–2 draw after extra time, winning its ninth cup title.

zh.s: 2016年斯洛文尼亚足球杯决赛是2015—16赛季该项赛事的决赛，决出第25届斯洛文尼亚顶级淘汰赛杯赛的冠军。比赛于2016年5月25日在科佩尔的博尼菲卡体育场举行。马里博尔与采列在加时赛后战成2比2，马里博尔最终通过点球大战获胜，夺得队史第九座杯赛冠军。

en.t: 2017 Montana's at-large congressional district special election
en.s: In Montana, an at-large congressional district special election was held on May 25, 2017, to determine the member of the United States House of Representatives for Montana's at-large congressional district. The election was necessitated by incumbent Republican Representative Ryan Zinke's appointment as United States Secretary of the Interior. Zinke resigned on March 1, 2017, upon his confirmation.

zh.t: 2017年蒙大拿州单一国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2017年5月25日，蒙大拿州举行单一国会选区特别选举，选出该州在美国众议院的代表。时任共和党众议员瑞安·津克获任美国内政部长，因此引发了这次选举。津克于2017年3月1日在任命获确认后辞去众议员职务。

en.t: Thirty-sixth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland
en.s: The Thirty-sixth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland (previously bill no. 29 of 2018) is an amendment to the Constitution of Ireland which permits the Oireachtas to legislate for abortion. The constitution had previously prohibited abortion, unless there was a serious risk to the life of the mother.
en.n: Ireland votes to repeal the Eighth Amendment of their constitution that prohibits abortion in all but a few cases, choosing to replace it with the Thirty-sixth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland.

zh.t: 爱尔兰宪法第三十六修正案
zh.s: 爱尔兰宪法第三十六修正案（此前称2018年第29号法案）是爱尔兰宪法修正案，允许议会立法规范堕胎。此前，除非怀孕对孕妇生命构成严重威胁，宪法禁止堕胎。
zh.n: 爱尔兰举行投票，决定废除宪法第八修正案。该修正案除少数情况外禁止堕胎；投票结果是以宪法第三十六修正案取而代之。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Latvia to the European Parliament was held on 25 May 2019. The previous elections were held in 2014. The election uses the Sainte-Laguë method, which is weighted against the larger parties. That explains why, according to the results of one opinion poll, parties with 6% of the vote would be allocated one seat each, while a party with 17% of the vote would also be allocated only one seat.

zh.s: 2019年5月25日，拉脱维亚举行选举，选出派往欧洲议会的议员。上次选举于2014年举行。本次采用圣拉古法分配席位，这种方法对大党相对不利。因此，根据一项民调结果，得票率为6%的政党可各获1席，而得票率达到17%的政党也只能获得1席。

en.s: The 2019 European Parliament election was held in Malta on 25 May 2019. 8 different political parties took part in the election, of which, only 2 won seats in the European Parliament; the Labour Party and the Nationalist Party, with 4 and 2 seats respectively.

zh.s: 2019年5月25日，马耳他举行欧洲议会选举。共有8个政党参选，其中只有两个党赢得席位：工党获4席，国民党获2席。

en.s: Elections for the 2019 European Parliament election took place in Slovakia on 25 May 2019. Thirty-one parties featured on the electoral list. The election was won by alliance of Progressive Slovakia and TOGETHER - Civic Democracy. It was the first election since 2006 that was won by some other party than Direction – Social Democracy.

zh.s: 2019年5月25日，斯洛伐克举行欧洲议会选举，共有31个政党列入选票。进步斯洛伐克党与“在一起—公民民主”联盟获胜。这是自2006年以来，首次由方向—社会民主党以外的政党赢得选举。

en.s: The 2019 EFL League Two play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 2019 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Newport County and Tranmere Rovers to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL League Two to EFL League One.

zh.s: 2019年英格兰足球联赛第二级（英乙）附加赛决赛于2019年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由纽波特郡对阵特兰米尔流浪者。比赛决出第三支、也是最后一支从英乙升入英格兰足球联赛第一级（英甲）的球队。

en.s: The 2019 Magyar Kupa final was the final match of the 2018–19 Magyar Kupa, played between Honvéd and Vidi on 25 May 2019 at the Groupama Arena in Budapest, Hungary.

zh.s: 2019年匈牙利杯决赛是2018—19赛季该项赛事的最后一场比赛，于2019年5月25日在匈牙利布达佩斯的格鲁帕马竞技场举行，对阵双方是汉维特和维迪队。

en.s: The 2019 Scottish Cup Final was the 134th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 2018–19 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match took place at Hampden Park on 25 May 2019 and was contested by Heart of Midlothian and Celtic. This was the fourth time that the two clubs had met in a Scottish Cup final with the previous finals being in 1901, 1907 and 1956.

zh.s: 2019年苏格兰杯决赛是第134届苏格兰杯决赛，也是2018—19赛季苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球赛事的决赛。比赛于2019年5月25日在汉普顿公园举行，由哈茨对阵凯尔特人。这是两队第4次在苏格兰杯决赛相遇；此前3次决赛分别在1901年、1907年和1956年举行。

en.s: The 2019 Cupa României final is the final match of the 2018–19 Cupa României and the 81st final of the Cupa României, Romania's premier football cup competition. It was played on 25 May 2019 between Astra Giurgiu and Viitorul Constanța. Astra Giurgiu reached their third cup final in the club's existence.

zh.s: 2019年罗马尼亚杯决赛是2018—19赛季罗马尼亚杯的最后一场比赛，也是罗马尼亚顶级足球杯赛第81届决赛。比赛于2019年5月25日举行，由久尔久阿斯特拉对阵康斯坦察维托鲁。久尔久阿斯特拉队史第三次闯入杯赛决赛。

en.t: 2019 European Parliament election in the Czech Republic
en.s: The 2019 European Parliament election in the Czech Republic was held on 24 and 25 May 2019, electing the 21 members of the Czech delegation to the European Parliament as part of the European elections held across the European Union. The result was a victory of the populist ruling party ANO (ALDE), with 21.18 per cent and 6 seats, 2 more seats than in 2014 election.

zh.s: 2019年5月24日至25日，捷克举行欧洲议会选举，选出21名捷克籍欧洲议会议员，是欧盟范围欧洲议会选举的一部分。民粹主义执政党不满公民行动党（ANO，欧洲自由民主联盟党团）获胜，得票率为21.18%，赢得6席，比2014年多2席。

en.s: The 2019 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2018–19 DFB-Pokal, the 76th season of the annual German football cup competition. The match was played on 25 May 2019 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. The match featured Bundesliga clubs RB Leipzig, playing in their first final, and Bayern Munich, the record winners of the competition. Bayern Munich won the final 3–0 for their 19th DFB-Pokal title.

zh.s: 2019年德国杯决赛决出了2018—19赛季德国杯冠军，这是该项年度足球杯赛的第76个赛季的决赛。比赛于2019年5月25日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行，对阵双方是首次闯入决赛的德甲球队莱比锡RB和德国杯夺冠次数最多的拜仁慕尼黑。拜仁以3比0获胜，队史第19次夺得德国杯。

en.s: The 2019 Double or Nothing was the inaugural Double or Nothing and inaugural professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW). It took place during Memorial Day weekend on May 25, 2019, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in the Las Vegas suburb of Paradise, Nevada. The event aired through traditional PPV outlets, as well as on B/R Live in North America and FITE TV internationally.

zh.s: 2019年《孤注一掷》（Double or Nothing）是该系列首场赛事，也是全精英摔角（AEW）举办的首场职业摔角付费赛事。赛事于2019年5月25日阵亡将士纪念日周末在内华达州拉斯维加斯郊区天堂市的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。赛事通过传统付费渠道播出，也在北美地区的B/R Live和国际市场的FITE TV播出。

en.s: The 2019 Copa del Rey final was a football match played on 25 May 2019 that decided the winner of the 2018–19 Copa del Rey, the 117th edition of Spain's primary football cup (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was played at the Estadio Benito Villamarín in Seville between Barcelona and Valencia.

zh.s: 2019年国王杯决赛于2019年5月25日举行，决出2018—19赛季国王杯冠军。这是西班牙顶级足球杯赛的第117届赛事（其中有两个赛季曾出现两个相互竞争的版本）。比赛在塞维利亚的贝尼托·比利亚马林球场举行，由巴塞罗那对阵瓦伦西亚。

en.s: The 2019 Taça de Portugal final was the last match of the 2018–19 Taça de Portugal, which decided the winners of the 79th season of the Taça de Portugal. It was played on 25 May 2019 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, between Sporting CP and Porto. The defending champions were Desportivo das Aves, however, they were knocked out in the quarter-finals by Braga.

zh.s: 2019年葡萄牙杯决赛是2018—19赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，决出了该项赛事第79个赛季的冠军。比赛于2019年5月25日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，参赛双方是里斯本竞技和波尔图。卫冕冠军阿维斯体育在四分之一决赛中被布拉加淘汰。

en.s: The 2019 Pro14 Grand Final was the final match of the 2018–19 Pro14 season. The 2018–19 season is the fifth with Guinness as the title sponsor, the tenth with a Grand Final and the second season with 14 teams, following the admission of two South African teams. The final was played between Glasgow Warriors and Leinster and was played at the 60,000 seater, Celtic Park in Glasgow.

zh.s: 2019年Pro14联赛总决赛是2018—19赛季该联赛的最后一场比赛。该赛季是吉尼斯冠名赞助的第五个赛季，是设立总决赛后的第十个赛季，也是南非两支球队加入后、联赛扩军至14队的第二个赛季。决赛由格拉斯哥勇士队对阵伦斯特，比赛在格拉斯哥可容纳6万人的凯尔特人公园球场举行。

en.s: The 72nd annual Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 25 May 2019. Mexican filmmaker Alejandro González Iñárritu served as jury president for the main competition. South Korean filmmaker Bong Joon-ho won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the drama film Parasite, becoming the first Korean to win the award. The Honorary Palme d'Or was awarded to French actor Alain Delon.

zh.s: 第72届戛纳电影节于2019年5月14日至25日举行。墨西哥导演亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊纳里图担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。韩国导演奉俊昊凭剧情片《寄生虫》获得电影节最高奖金棕榈奖，成为首位获此奖的韩国人。荣誉金棕榈奖颁给了法国演员阿兰·德龙。

en.s: The 2022 UEFA Europa Conference League final was the final match of the 2021–22 UEFA Europa Conference League, the first season of Europe's tertiary club football tournament organised by UEFA. It was played on 25 May 2022 at the Arena Kombëtare in Tirana, Albania, between Italian club Roma and Dutch club Feyenoord.

zh.s: 2022年欧洲协会联赛决赛是2021—22赛季欧洲协会联赛的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲足联主办的欧洲第三级别俱乐部足球赛事首个赛季的决赛。比赛于2022年5月25日在阿尔巴尼亚地拉那的国家竞技场举行，由意大利罗马对阵荷兰费耶诺德。

en.s: The battle of Nzacko took place from March 5, 2022 to May 25, 2022, with Coalition of Patriots for Change (CPC) fighters from the Popular Front for the Rebirth of Central African Republic (FPRC) and Union for Peace in the Central African Republic (UPC) fighting against FACA and allied Wagner Group mercenaries.

en.s: The 2022 A-Leagues All Stars Game was the third edition of the A-Leagues All Stars Game, and the first since the 2014 Game. It was held at Accor Stadium in Sydney on 25 May 2022 against Spanish club Barcelona. Barcelona won the game 3–2. The game was televised in Australia on Network 10.

zh.t: 2022年澳大利亚职业足球联赛全明星赛
zh.s: 2022年澳大利亚职业足球联赛全明星赛是第三届全明星赛，也是自2014年以来首次举办。比赛于2022年5月25日在悉尼的雅高体育场举行，对阵双方是澳大利亚职业足球联赛全明星队和西班牙俱乐部巴塞罗那。巴塞罗那以3比2获胜。比赛在澳大利亚由第十频道转播。

en.s: The siege of Madjoari began in February 2021 and lasted until May 25, 2022, as part of the jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso. Jihadists from Ansarul Islam and Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin began attacking the city, controlled by Burkinabe forces and the pro-government Volunteers for the Defense of the Homeland (VDP), and ambushed Burkinabe troops and cut off supply lines.

zh.s: 马焦阿里的围困战于2021年2月开始，持续至2022年5月25日，是布基纳法索圣战组织叛乱的一部分。来自“伊斯兰卫士”组织以及“支持伊斯兰和穆斯林组织”的圣战分子开始袭击由布基纳法索政府军和亲政府的“保卫祖国志愿者”（VDP）控制的城镇，并伏击布基纳法索部队、切断补给线。
