en.s: The 2023 Gazipur City Corporation election was a local government election in the city of Gazipur, Bangladesh, held on 25 May 2023 to elect the Mayor of Gazipur and the Gazipur City Council. A total of eight candidates participated in the election. The election resulted in a victory for independent candidate Jayeda Khatun. In the 76-member City Council, the Awami League won 61 seats, while the Bangladesh Nationalist Party won 15 seats.

zh.s: 2023年5月25日，孟加拉国加济布尔市举行地方选举，选出市长和市议会议员。共有8名候选人参选，独立候选人杰耶达·哈敦当选。在市议会76席中，人民联盟赢得61席，孟加拉国民族主义党赢得15席。

en.s: The 2023 Puntland municipal elections took place on Thursday, May 25, 2023, in the Puntland state of Somalia. The elections were the second time the autonomous region had held one-person, one-vote elections.

zh.s: 索马里邦特兰州于2023年5月25日（星期四）举行市政选举。这是该自治地区第二次举行一人一票的选举。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Delhi on 25 May 2024 to elect 7 members of the 18th Lok Sabha. The result of the election were declared on 4 June 2024.

zh.s: 2024年5月25日，印度德里举行大选投票，选出第18届人民院的7名议员。选举结果于6月4日公布。

en.t: King and Queen of the Ring (2024)
en.s: King and Queen of the Ring was a 2024 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 12th King of the Ring event, but under a new name, and took place on May 25, 2024, at the Jeddah Super Dome in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: “摔角之王与女王”是美国公司WWE举办的2024年职业摔角付费点播和网络直播赛事，参赛者来自WWE主力品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是“摔角之王”系列的第12届赛事，首次采用“摔角之王与女王”这一名称。赛事于2024年5月25日在沙特阿拉伯吉达的吉达超级穹顶体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2024 Scottish Cup final was the final match of the 2023–24 Scottish Cup, the 139th edition of Scotland's most prestigious knockout football competition. It was contested by Celtic and Rangers at Hampden Park, Glasgow, on 25 May 2024.

zh.s: 2024年苏格兰杯决赛是2023—24赛季苏格兰杯的最后一场比赛，也是苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球赛事第139届决赛。比赛于2024年5月25日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，由凯尔特人对阵流浪者。

en.s: The 2024 FA Cup final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 25 May 2024 to determine the winners of the 2023–24 FA Cup, Manchester United. It was the 143rd final of English football's primary cup competition in the Football Association Challenge Cup. The final was contested between holders Manchester City and local rivals Manchester United.

zh.s: 2024年英格兰足总杯决赛于2024年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决出2023—24赛季足总杯冠军，曼联获胜。这是英格兰足协挑战杯、即英格兰顶级杯赛的第143届决赛。对阵双方是卫冕冠军曼城和同城对手曼联。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Haryana on 25 May 2024 to elect 10 members of the 18th Lok Sabha.

zh.t: 2024年印度大选哈里亚纳邦投票
zh.s: 2024年5月25日，印度哈里亚纳邦举行大选投票，选出第18届人民院的10名议员。

en.s: The 2024 A-League Men Grand Final, known officially as the Isuzu UTE A-League Grand Final, was a soccer match that was played between Central Coast Mariners and Melbourne Victory on 25 May 2024 at Central Coast Stadium in Gosford, Australia. The match determined the champions of the A-League Men and was the 19th A-League Men Grand Final, the culmination of the 2023–24 season.

zh.s: 2024年澳洲联赛男子总决赛正式名称为伊苏祖UTD澳洲联赛总决赛，于2024年5月25日在澳大利亚戈斯福德的中央海岸体育场举行，由中央海岸水手对阵墨尔本胜利。比赛决出澳洲男子联赛冠军，是第19届澳洲联赛男子总决赛，也是2023—24赛季的收官战。

en.s: The 2024 UEFA Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2023–24 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 23rd season of Europe's premier women's club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 15th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup to the UEFA Women's Champions League. The match was played at the San Mamés Stadium in Bilbao, Spain, on 25 May 2024, between Spanish club Barcelona and French club Lyon, a repeat of the 2019 and 2022 finals.

zh.s: 2024年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2023—24赛季该项赛事的决赛，为欧洲足联主办的欧洲顶级女子俱乐部足球赛事第23个赛季、赛事从欧洲女子联盟杯更名为欧洲女子冠军联赛后的第15个赛季的收官战。比赛于2024年5月25日在西班牙毕尔巴鄂圣马梅斯球场举行，由西班牙巴塞罗那对阵法国里昂。这也是两队继2019年和2022年之后第三次在决赛相遇。

en.s: The 2024 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2023–24 DFB-Pokal, the 81st season of the annual German football cup competition. The match was played on 25 May 2024 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. The match featured 1. FC Kaiserslautern, a 2. Bundesliga side, and Bundesliga champions Bayer Leverkusen. Leverkusen won the match 1–0 for their second DFB-Pokal title.

zh.s: 2024年德国杯决赛决出了2023—24赛季德国杯冠军，这是该项年度足球杯赛的第81个赛季的决赛。比赛于2024年5月25日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。对阵双方是德乙球队凯泽斯劳滕和德甲冠军勒沃库森。勒沃库森以1比0获胜，第二次夺得德国杯。

en.s: The 2024 Greek Cup final was the 80th final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 25 May 2024 at Panthessaliko Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and Aris. It was Panathinaikos' thirty first Greek Cup final in their 116 years of existence and Aris' tenth Greek Cup final of their 110-year history.

zh.s: 2024年希腊杯决赛是该赛事的第80届决赛，于2024年5月25日在潘塞萨利科体育场举行。参赛双方是帕纳辛奈科斯和阿里斯。这是帕纳辛奈科斯建队116年来第31次进入希腊杯决赛，也是阿里斯110年队史上的第10次。

en.s: The 2024 Coupe de France final was a football match between Lyon and Paris Saint-Germain to decide the winner of the 2023–24 Coupe de France, the 107th season of the Coupe de France. Due to the upgrade works at the Stade de France for the Olympic Games and Paralympics, the final was relocated to the Stade Pierre-Mauroy in Villeneuve-d'Ascq.

zh.s: 2024年法国杯决赛由里昂对阵巴黎圣日耳曼，决出2023—24赛季法国杯冠军，也是该赛事第107个赛季的决赛。由于法兰西体育场正在为奥运会和残奥会升级改造，决赛改在维伦纽夫达斯克的皮埃尔·莫鲁瓦球场举行。

en.s: The 2024 European Rugby Champions Cup final was the final match of the 2023–24 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the 29th European club rugby final in general. It was contested by Leinster and Toulouse, the two most decorated clubs in the competition's history. The Tottenham Hotspur Stadium was the host venue of the final, becoming the second stadium in London to host the final after Twickenham Stadium.

zh.s: 2024年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2023—24赛季该赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球赛事第29次举办决赛。参赛双方是赛事历史上夺冠次数最多的两支球队——伦斯特和图卢兹。决赛在托特纳姆热刺球场举行，这是伦敦继特威克纳姆球场之后，第二座承办该赛事决赛的球场。

en.s: The 77th annual Cannes Film Festival took place from 14 to 25 May 2024. American filmmaker and actress Greta Gerwig served as jury president for the main competition. American filmmaker Sean Baker won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the comedy-drama film Anora. The official poster for the festival featuring a still image from the movie Rhapsody in August (1991) by Akira Kurosawa, selected for the 44th edition, was designed by Hartland Villa.

zh.s: 第77届戛纳电影节于2024年5月14日至25日举行。美国导演兼演员格蕾塔·葛韦格担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。美国导演肖恩·贝克凭喜剧剧情片《阿诺拉》获得电影节最高奖金棕榈奖。电影节官方海报由Hartland Villa设计，采用了黑泽明1991年电影《八月狂想曲》的一幅剧照；该片曾入选第44届戛纳电影节。

en.s: The 2025 EFL League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 25 May 2025 at Wembley Stadium, London, to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL League One, the third tier of English football, to the EFL Championship.

zh.s: 2025年英格兰足球联赛第三级附加赛决赛于2025年5月25日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决出第三支、也是最后一支从英甲（英格兰第三级联赛）升入英冠的球队。

en.s: The 2025 Battleground, also promoted as Battleground: Tampa, was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental brand, NXT. It was the third annual Battleground produced by WWE for NXT and the eighth Battleground overall. The event took place during Memorial Day weekend on May 25, 2025, at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida.

zh.s: 2025年《战场》赛事也以“战场：坦帕”为宣传名称，是WWE举办的一场职业摔角网络直播赛事，参赛者仅限于WWE旗下发展品牌NXT的摔角手。这是WWE为NXT举办的第3届年度《战场》赛事，也是系列第8届。赛事于2025年5月25日阵亡将士纪念日周末在佛罗里达州坦帕的于恩林中心举行。

en.s: The 2025 Taça de Portugal final was the last match of the 2024–25 Taça de Portugal, which decided the winner of the 85th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier knockout cup competition in Portuguese football. It was played on 25 May 2025 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, between Primeira Liga and Lisbon rivals Benfica and Sporting CP.

zh.s: 2025年葡萄牙杯决赛是2024—25赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，决出了该项葡萄牙顶级足球淘汰赛杯赛第85个赛季的冠军。比赛于2025年5月25日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，参赛双方是葡超球队、里斯本同城对手本菲卡和里斯本竞技。

en.s: The 2025 Tajik Supercup was the 16th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajikistan Higher League and Tajikistan Cup. The match was contested by 2024 League champions Istiklol, and Cup Champions Regar-TadAZ.

zh.s: 2025年塔吉克斯坦超级杯是第16届塔吉克斯坦超级杯。这项年度足球赛事由上赛季塔吉克斯坦高级联赛冠军与塔吉克斯坦杯冠军交锋。参赛球队为2024年联赛冠军伊斯蒂克洛尔和杯赛冠军雷加尔-塔达兹。
